title: Twelve Beds at 29th and Dearborn: Provident Hospital Opens
conflicts: First graduates: October 1892 (Mapping Care, citing the Chicago Tribune) vs 1894 (International Museum of Surgical Science); story uses October 1892. Refusal and meeting: 1889/1890 (Provident Foundation) vs December 1890 (Buckler); story gives Buckler's date, attributed. Armour: company down payment (Provident Foundation, Hektoen) vs P. D. Armour's personal 200 dollars (Buckler); story says only that an Armour commitment helped with the down payment. 189 patients is first-year in Buckler but 1897 in the Provident Foundation; not used.
notes: Buckler (1954) is novelistic with reconstructed dialogue; only one line of Williams's (also quoted by IMSS) and the phrase most rigid are quoted, both attributed. Archive.org copies of the Provident Foundation and Northwestern pages are used because the originals are gone. The 1893 heart operation is a different episode and is left out.
